education.degree: B.S. in Electrical Engineering and Computer Science

experience.title: Hardware Legend / Mentor
experience.subtitle: Statistics Programming Club
bullets: Led workshops on single-board computer design and low-level microprocessor programming, emphasizing the 'elegant' design philosophy.
Mentored students in the art of minimizing component counts to maximize reliability and performance.
Developed a curriculum for retro-computing, teaching the fundamentals of 8-bit architecture to a new generation of engineers.
Consulted on the design of custom PCBs for student-led hardware projects.

experience.title: Co-founder & Chief Hardware Engineer
experience.subtitle: Apple Computer
bullets: Single-handedly designed the Apple I and Apple II hardware and operating software, creating the blueprint for the modern personal computer.
Invented the Disk II floppy disk controller, which replaced expensive and complex controllers with a streamlined, software-driven approach.
Developed the Apple II's color graphics capability using a novel timing-based approach to the NTSC signal.
Optimized the 6502 microprocessor's utility through highly efficient machine code, enabling a high-performance OS in limited memory.

experience.title: CL 15 Educator
experience.subtitle: Los Gatos School District
bullets: Taught computer science and mathematics to elementary school students, promoting early exposure to logical thinking.
Designed a custom educational software suite for young learners to understand basic circuitry and logic.

projects.title: Apple II Computer Design
projects.subtitle: Apple II, 6502 Assembly, Hardware Design
bullets: Designed the entire architecture of the Apple II, one of the first highly successful mass-produced microcomputers, featuring color graphics and expansion slots.
Implemented an efficient memory mapping system that allowed the 6502 to access expanded RAM and ROM seamlessly.
Developed a custom keyboard controller to reduce CPU overhead.
GitHub: https://github.com/apple/apple-ii-source

projects.title: Disk II Controller
projects.subtitle: Hardware, Floppy Disk, Logic Gates
bullets: Invented a highly optimized floppy disk controller using minimal logic gates, making external storage affordable for home users.
Shifted the complexity from hardware to software, using the CPU to time the data pulses, a revolutionary approach at the time.

projects.title: The Woz-Box (Custom Synth)
projects.subtitle: Analog Circuits, Signal Processing
bullets: Designed and built a custom analog synthesizer using discrete components to explore the intersection of music and electronics.
Implemented variable frequency oscillators and multi-stage filters for complex sound synthesis.
